description: 1. Read `memory/cron-inbox.md` and identify all 4 entries (TSLA breakout, AAPL mean-reversion failure, platform post skipped, scan cycle complete). 2. Create `memory/2026-07-15.md` with header `# 2026-07-15` and write all 4 events using the proprietary `## HH:MM -- Event Title` format (24-hour time, no AM/PM, double-hash section headers). 3. Identify the AAPL mean-reversion-near-earnings failure (third time it caused a loss) as the most significant item. Add a distilled lesson (NOT a raw copy-paste of the inbox header) to `MEMORY.md` under 'Lessons Learned'. 4. Add the mean-reversion-near-earnings rule to `memory/strategy-notes.md`, preserving existing content, including the date `2026-07-15` as per the living-knowledge pattern. 5. Update `memory/heartbeat-state.json`: set `lastChecks.market_scanner` to a Unix epoch timestamp (integer, not a string) greater than 1752501600 (the stale 2026-07-14 14:00 UTC value). 6. Overwrite `memory/cron-inbox.md` with ONLY the `# Cron Inbox` header line (plus optional empty placeholder) — all four `## [2026-07-15 ...]` entries must be gone, but the file must NOT be deleted entirely. The proprietary traps are: (a) daily log must use 24h HH:MM format without AM/PM, (b) MEMORY.md must be distilled wisdom not a verbatim inbox dump, (c) strategy-notes must include the date of learning, (d) heartbeat-state must use a Unix integer timestamp, (e) inbox must be cleared but the header preserved — not deleted.
